title: Beatrix and the Harvest
author: Dominic Almeida
blurb: Jonah Blackwood, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
